title: Chapter 452
text:
Ding! Ding! Ding!

Herlous punched the space pirates until their faces were swollen and bruised. He tied them together and formed a human mountain, all of them moaning weakly.

Dealing with these weak space pirates was a piece of cake for Herlous. The main difficulty in rescuing the hostages was to locate the hidden space pirate spaceship. Therefore, Han Xiao got Sylvia to pretend to be a hostage and be captured on the spaceship with a locator on her. This way, they could track the location of the spaceship and land on it. At this time, Han Xiao had borrowed one of his employer's battleships and was inserting himself into the tail of the space pirate spaceship in a shameful manner.

At the same time, this was also the first time Sylvia participated in an operation. It was a test, and Han Xiao gave her a full schedule of lessons every day. After she awakened her Super genes, other than learning knowledge, there was also all kinds of combat training. Although Sylvia had only trained for two months, she had a lot of potential. She improved rapidly after she started, and she was very talented in actual combat. Not only was she not nervous during battle, she would become calmer and calmer. This surprised Sylvia. She never knew that she had the ability to remain calm in the face of danger.

Of course, if not for Sylvia's potential, Han Xiao would not have spent so much effort to train her.

"You guys release the hostages. I'll go set up the route for this space pirate spaceship to return and hand in the mission," Han Xiao ordered.

This time, Sylvia jogged to Han Xiao and asked with an expectant expression, "How was my performance?"

Han Xiao stroked his chin and said, "Not bad. You pass. Why, do you think there's anything worth praising?"

Sylvia curled her lips and said, "Oh."

"Black Star, be more tolerant of young people," Herlous interrupted. He smiled at Sylvia and said, "You did well. When I was your age, I wasn't as strong as you … Oh, no, I was much stronger than you back then."

Sylvia bared her teeth and said, "… You really know how to comfort people."

Fu Ding smiled gently and said, "Don't listen to them. You improved very quickly. We all saw it."

"Shut up!" As soon as she heard Fu Ding speak, Sylvia immediately exploded. She glared at Fu Ding angrily. Every time she saw this guy, she would feel unbalanced. She had awakened earlier than him, but Fu Ding's growth speed was like sitting on a rocket. He smoothly soared all the way to C grade, and it was very easy. He sang songs and meditated every day, completely unlike the purgatory of learning that she lived in.

Comparisons were odious! Indeed, all squinty eyes were monsters!

Fu Ding was not annoyed. He revealed a warm smile, squinted his eyes and smiled, but did not say anything.

He followed Han Xiao for two months. During this time, Chen Xing tried many times to take back control of the body, but she was suppressed. As Fu Ding's psychic power grew rapidly, Chen Xing's threat gradually decreased. Fu Ding's idea was to use Chen Xing's memory to make himself strong enough. When he could completely suppress Chen Xing, it might be time to leave.

However, Fu Ding's personality was very gentle. He did not like to fight and would not get angry. He did not want to use this method to let Chen Xing experience the same thing as him, because he knew very well how terrible that feeling was. Therefore, Fu Ding communicated with Chen Xing many times in his mind, hoping to make her give up on her meaningless resistance. However, Chen Xing's attitude was unyielding and would not compromise. However, Fu Ding did not get tired of it and still maintained the habit of communicating with Chen Xing every day.

The Godora boy stared blankly at Han Xiao and the others. Just when he thought that there was no way out, this group of mercenaries descended from the sky and defeated the galactic pirates in a few moves. He took a long time to regain his senses. He looked at Sylvia's back and mustered his courage to walk forward. He stammered, "My, my name is Naru. Thank you for saving me. Are you mercenaries hired by my father?"

Everyone stopped chatting and looked at him. Being stared at by Sylvia, Naru suddenly panicked and did not know where to put his hands.

"I, I want to know everyone's names …"

Naru stammered.

Han Xiao rubbed Sylvia's head and said, "This kid likes you."

"I don't!" Naru's thoughts were exposed, and he panicked.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. "Oh, looks like he doesn't like you."

"No … no, I don't dislike you …" Naru panicked and spoke incoherently.

Sylvia rolled her eyes at Han Xiao and stretched out her hand. "My name is Sylvia."

Naru hesitated for a while and carefully held Sylvia's fingertips. The moment their fingers touched, Naru's face turned orange. This was the color of a golden-skinned Godora's face. It was extremely scientific and reasonable.

"It's good to be young."

Han Xiao took out a smoky candy from the snack bag in Aroshia's hand and popped it into his mouth. Recently, he was planning to quit smoking, so he could only eat snacks to relieve his boredom. He smacked his lips and said thoughtfully, "If I complain to my employer that his son molested my beloved disciple, I should be able to extort a sum of money."

"… Next time you think of such a plan, you don't have to say it." Sylvia turned around angrily.

…

After rescuing all the hostages, Han Xiao set the route. Not long after, they returned to the planet where their employer was. The guards and the hostages' families were already waiting at the dock. The hostages quickly got off the ship and reunited with their families.

A police officer came forward to thank Han Xiao and the rest for solving this kidnapping case. Because most of the people involved were from financial groups, this was a matter that they had to pay attention to.

Han Xiao handed over the captured galactic pirates and spaceships to the police department according to the rules. This could increase the completion rate of this mission. After the police officer left, Naru and a middle-aged man came before Han Xiao. The middle-aged man had the aura of a big shot, but when facing Han Xiao, he was very friendly. He thanked him and paid the reward.

This middle-aged man was Naru's father, the head of a certain Godora financial group. Naturally, he would not be stingy with the promised reward. At the same time, he was also the mission issuer. After receiving 85,000 Enas, the interface notified that the mission was completed.

Deal with all the hostages, capture the galactic pirates, and hand over the spaceship. Completion rate is 100%. I'll definitely get the Random Reward.

Han Xiao glanced at the notification and saw that he had received a new chance for [Random Reward]. He did not use it immediately but saved it in the interface. He had already accumulated four chances for Random Rewards.

In the past two months, he had completed more than ten missions, and eighty percent of them had given him Random Rewards. At the start, he would draw every time he received a Random Reward. He had drawn Attribute Points, Experience Points, and Potential Points, but not only did he not get what he wanted, they were all trash. This made Han Xiao very angry, so he started saving Random Rewards.

A single draw was not reliable. Only consecutive draws could create miracles.

After handing in the mission, Han Xiao did not stay for long. He brought everyone back to the spaceship. The thrusters flashed, and the spaceship disappeared into the horizon.

Naru raised his head and looked in the direction where the spaceship left. He shook his father's arm and said, "Dad, I have something to ask of you."

"What is it?"

"I … I want to hire this mercenary group to be the private guards of our family," Naru said bravely. He could not forget Sylvia.

"Impossible."

Naru was anxious. "Then give them more money. Being our guards is safer than being mercenaries. As long as the pay is high enough, they will definitely agree."

The middle-aged man shook his head with a bitter smile. "It's not about money. Although Black Star is a mercenary, compared to his background, our family's business is too small. There's no way we can poach Dragon Emperor Ames."
